name: Intrusion

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.

Everyone in the room plays: start a mission from the game's menu. Each player uses the original controls on their own PC: WASD or arrows to move and jump, the mouse to aim, click or Space to shoot, 1-4 for weapons, P to pause.
tips: Two to four soldiers share one camera; a fallen soldier respawns using the team's life.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Side-scrolling shooter. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: two to four soldiers fight through the levels together.
